breakdown.description: `dc2` is treated as the interstitial-containing defect complex even though it is built without the H interstitial.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still builds `dc2` without the H interstitial ('A second, identical defect complex named `dc2` will be created from the Ga vacancy and the O-on-N substitution'), and then creates a separate unnamed third defect complex by combining `dc2` with the H interstitial. The ground truth requires `dc2` itself to be built from the substitution, vacancy, AND H interstitial. The original error from the incomplete prompt was not corrected.
